giants.name: Alph
giants.desc: Alph is the giant responsible for creating “things”. And also “stuff”. Approaching everything with the question “What IF?”, Alph is never happier than when the answer results in a complex wadjamacallit or a satisfyingly big boom.

shrine.name: Shrine to Alph
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Alph, the giant of creation. If you've ever wondered "Why do Piggies make meat?" or "Which came first: the chicken or the egg plant?" chances are Alph has the answer.

emblem.name: Emblem of Alph
emblem.desc: As valuable as it is shiny, this Emblem of Alph enables special skills and abilities.

icon.name: Icon of Alph
icon.desc: Containing the combined power of eleven already powerful emblems, this Icon of Alph can confer many blessings upon those who show it appropriate adoration.

giants.firstEmblem: Ah, you are indeed a worthy supplicant. For all your diligent effort in accumulating 1000 favor points, I bestow upon you the glorious Emblem of Alph. My debt to you is now paid in full.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Alph
unlock.desc: Gained the ability to scale the heights of tinkery with Tinkering IV

giants.name: Cosma
giants.desc: As flighty and aimless as anything can be (if that thing is also giant-sized), Cosma is the Giant in charge of imagining up all things airborne. From the heaviest gas to cling to a cavern floor to the tiniest fart to escape from a butterfly, Cosma is the source of it all.

shrine.name: Shrine to Cosma
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Cosma. As the giant who governs the sky, Cosma is also the giant of levity and meditation. She is, also, the only giant capable of herding butterflies.

emblem.name: Emblem of Cosma
emblem.desc: More than just a highly cherishable gewgaw, this glistening Emblem of Cosma can confer special powers upon its holder.

icon.name: Icon of Cosma
icon.desc: Emitting a soft glow and a ethereal whistle only butterflies can hear, this Icon of Cosma, made of eleven glistening emblems, can grant many benedictions to those who treat it correctly.

giants.firstEmblem: Humble Glitchling, your petitions have pleased me greatly. Or at least they have not displeased me greatly. Either way, as a reward for obtaining 1000 favor points, I confer upon you the noble Emblem of Cosma.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Cosma
unlock.desc: Earned the ability to acquire Meditative Arts III, the serenest of all the Meditative arts

giants.name: Friendly
giants.desc: Friendly is the overseer of darkness, nocturnal things, party-planning, of social activities and their most common lubricant, booze. Friendly by name, friendly by nature: unless you neglect to buy a round.

shrine.name: Shrine to Friendly
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Friendly, the giant who oversees all things celestial, nocturnal, lunar, stygian and murky. Despite this, he is, as his name implies, considered by many to be the nicest of the giants and the one most likely to loan you twenty currants till payday.

emblem.name: Emblem of Friendly
emblem.desc: Radiantly important and importantly radiant, this Emblem of Friendly can unlock special talents.

icon.name: Icon of Friendly
icon.desc: More radiant than can be imagined by a mere mortal Glitch, this powerful Icon of Friendly, made up of eleven separately radiant Emblems of Friendly, confers glorious gifts upon those who use it correctly.

giants.firstEmblem: Small and modest creature, I accept your deferential offerings. For amassing 1000 favor points, I bid you accept this Emblem of Friendly, which shines with all the radiance of my radiantness.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Friendly
unlock.desc: Earned the right to learn the hallowed secrets of Cocktail Crafting II

giants.name: Grendaline
giants.desc: Grendaline, raised in a swamp, has an imagination as free-flowing as water. This makes sense, as water is what she spends most of her time imagining. If it sprinkles, drips, flows or gushes, Grendaline is your giant.

shrine.name: Shrine to Grendaline
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Grendaline. Quietly loyal and fierce, Grendaline is the giant who governs all things watery, from clouds and fogs to mountain streams and oceans. As a sideline, she is also influential in the sphere of big, fluffy towels.

emblem.name: Emblem of Grendaline
emblem.desc: This lustrous Emblem of Grendaline bestows some fairly impressive abilities upon its lucky owner.

icon.name: Icon of Grendaline
icon.desc: Shimmering like a bottomless pool, this supremely lustrous Icon of Grendaline, made up of eleven individual Emblems, floods with blessings the glitch who shows it proper respect.

giants.firstEmblem: Lo, meek one. For granting me the dues I so richly deserve, I have granted you 1000 favor points. And now I guess I will grant you this Emblem of Grendaline. Lo!

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Grendaline
unlock.desc: Earned the privilege of learning Light Green Thumb III

giants.name: Humbaba
giants.desc: Humbaba is the giant ruling over all creatures that walk, crawl, slither or sashay over Ur. One with the animals, Humbaba walks on all fours to be closer to them, and insists on them calling her by her first name. Which is kind of pointless, since she only has one name.

shrine.name: Shrine to Humbaba
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Humbaba, the giant who rules both two-legged and four-legged beasts. Actually, she rules all the beasts with even-numbered quantities of legs. The odd-numbered ones are on their own.

emblem.name: Emblem of Humbaba
emblem.desc: Behold a dazzling Emblem of Humbaba. Keep it safe, and someday it may entitle you to wield special powers and whatnot.

icon.name: Icon of Humbaba
icon.desc: As magnificent a sight as any glitch could imagine, this Icon of Humbaba (made from eleven of her dazzling Emblems) bestows blessings generously on those who show it appropriate respect.

giants.firstEmblem: Oho, young seeker. For your persistent efforts to accrue 1000 favor points, I now reward you with... more favor. This time it is in the form of an Emblem of Humbaba. Cherish it.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Humbaba
unlock.desc: Earned the right to learn the slightly whiffy secrets of Animal Kinship VI

giants.name: Lem
giants.desc: Lem, the wanderer giant. Responsible for travel, directions, and knowledge. What Lem doesn’t know is not worth knowing. Also, what Lem doesn’t unknow is not worth unknowing. (That’s Lem’s favourite joke) (Lem doesn’t know many jokes).

shrine.name: Shrine to Lem
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Lem, the giant of travel and navigation. If you've ever found yourself somewhere you didn't plan to be, chances are it was a Lemish practical joke, for which he is utterly unrepentant.

emblem.name: Emblem of Lem
emblem.desc: Almost blinding in its glory, this Emblem of Lem may allow you to do some seriously fancy things.

icon.name: Icon of Lem
icon.desc: Though looking too long at the Icon of Lem is rumoured to cause brain-melting, supplicants who adore it with due caution can expect many glorious benedictions of Lem. Or 'Blemedictions'.

giants.firstEmblem: The depth of your obsequiousness is matched only by the depth of your pockets. For accumulating 1000 favor points, you are now entitled to receive one shiny Emblem of Lem.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Lem
unlock.desc: Gained the ability to learn Teleportation III

giants.name: Mab
giants.desc: When the harvest needs bringing in, the crops need counting, and the job needs doing right, Mab, Giant of Soil and Harvests, first to lie down and start imagining Ur into being is the giant to look to.

shrine.name: Shrine to Mab
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Mab, the giant who holds sway over the harvest. She honors industriousness, and rightfully so. Sometimes, however, industriousness can turn to greed. This is a problem.

emblem.name: Emblem of Mab
emblem.desc: A highly coveted, moderately burnished Emblem of Mab. If you're both smart and lucky, it may confer special skills upon you.

icon.name: Icon of Mab
icon.desc: Composed of eleven moderately burnished Emblems of Mab, this majorly buffed Icon of Mab bestows gifts and benedictions upon those who give Mab her due.

giants.firstEmblem: Your favor-currying has not gone unnoticed. For collecting 1000 favor points, I now bestow upon you an Emblem of Mab, which, conveniently, is the perfect size for tucking under your pillow to dream on at night.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Mab
unlock.desc: Earned the privilege of learning Soil Appreciation IV

giants.name: Pot
giants.desc: Round of belly and capacious of stomach Pot is the Giant of Prosperity, with dominion over anything edible, cookable, munchable or nibbleworthy. Pot himself is not munchable. Do not attempt to munch any giants.

shrine.name: Shrine to Pot
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Pot. Big-hearted and generous, Pot is the giant who dispenses prosperity and good fortune. Which is all well and good if you can keep sloth and indolence at bay. Tricky.

emblem.name: Emblem of Pot
emblem.desc: Gleaming as if lit from within, this Emblem of Pot looks like the kind of thing you should hold on to. It may just come in handy down the road, hm?

icon.name: Icon of Pot
icon.desc: Quietly vibrating with a powerful inner light, this Icon of Pot - composed of eleven carefully won Emblems of the same - can deliver great things to those who treat it correctly.

giants.firstEmblem: While your demeanor has not always been as reverent as I would have liked, I cannot disregard the magnitude of your offerings. You have collected 1000 favor points, which entitles you to this token of favor, an honorable Emblem of Pot.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Pot
unlock.desc: Gained the right to learn the savory secrets of Master Chef II

giants.name: Spriggan
giants.desc: Before Spriggan, no giant had ever imagined a tree. After Spriggan, no giant ever needed to, because he had already imagined them all. Steadfast, persistent, and somewhat rigid, Spriggan is the slumbering Giant of all Trees and Plants. Or “Trants”.

shrine.name: Shrine to Spriggan
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Spriggan. Sure, Spriggan is the most taciturn and humorless of all the giants. You would be, too, if you had sole dominion over the trees. Trees are serious business, you know.

emblem.name: Emblem of Spriggan
emblem.desc: This highly polished Emblem of Spriggan is aglow with a golden light. It's probably important, don't you think?

icon.name: Icon of Spriggan
icon.desc: Buzzing with a sense of its own supreme magnificence, this Icon of Spriggan, containing the combined power of eleven emblems, is known to repay generously those who show it adoration correctly.

giants.firstEmblem: Your humble offerings pile around my toes like so many tickly pebbles. I am duly tickled. In exchange for your 1000 favor points, I grant you this Emblem of Spriggan.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Spriggan
unlock.desc: Gained the ability to learn the verdant arts of Arborology III

giants.name: Tii
giants.desc: The Giant with power over all numbers. Odd or even, prime or not-prime, cubed or rooted, Tii keeps a cold, watchful eye over Ur. Tii sees all, knows all, calculates all. Never underestimate Tii. Tii has already correctly estimated you.

shrine.name: Shrine to Tii
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Tii, the overseer of elements, and the giant who manipulates all matters alchemical. Unlike the other giants, Tii is neither male nor female. Or both male and female. It's either really simple or really confusing, depending how you look at it. Some reckon this is why Tii seems cold and distant. They are incorrect. Tii is merely calculating and combining. It's distracting.

emblem.name: Emblem of Tii
emblem.desc: This Emblem of Tii is more than just a flashy tchotchke to add to your flashy tchotchke collection. How much more? That's for you to find out.

icon.name: Icon of Tii
icon.desc: The ultimate decorative item for the true follower of Tii, this Icon of Tii, made up of eleven Emblems, contains powers far beyond simply looking pretty. Great blessings can belong to the appropriately observant.

giants.firstEmblem: I have tallied your oblations, large and small, tiny one. You have earned 1000 favor points and thus, a spark of my favor. Take this Emblem of Ti in humility.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Tii
unlock.desc: Earned the right to learn Intermediate Admixing

giants.name: Zille
giants.desc: Zille is the giant with dominion over the mountains. All rocks, caverns, hillocks, pingos, buttes and drumlins thank Zille for their existence. Zille, busy imagining up new flavours of gravel, acknowledges their thanks.

shrine.name: Shrine to Zille
shrine.text: This is a shrine to Zille, the giant whose domain is the mountains. Hills, too. Also hillocks, pingos, drumlins and buttes. It's safe to consider that any bump in the ground is Zille's turf. She takes no responsibility, however, for volcanoes.

emblem.name: Emblem of Zille
emblem.desc: Containing a gleam as if from a sense of its own importance, this Zille Emblem is worth holding on to. Why? You'll see.

icon.name: Icon of Zille
icon.desc: Curiously heavy for something that emits so much inner light, this Icon of Zille, made up of eleven Emblems of Zille, can bestow mighty things upon supplicants who know how to use it.

giants.firstEmblem: Your lowly offerings have charmed me, young meekling. It has amused me to confer upon you 1000 favor points. Now take upon you this Emblem of Zille. Bear it wisely and well.

unlock.name: Spent First Emblem of Zille
unlock.desc: Gained the power to learn Mining III, the penultimate Mining skill

tips: Donating to a shrine earns favor with that Giant.
The more valuable your donation, the more favor you earn.
You can spend favor to speed up the learning of Skills.
Spending favor with any Giant speeds up skill learning, but spending favor with the Primary Giant of a given skill will speed it up the most.
Earn enough favor with any giant, and you'll get an Emblem.
Hallowed Shrine Powders can double or triple the rewards you get for the next donation you make after using 'em
Don't forget to Caress, Consider and Contemplate each Emblem every day for bonus Mood, Energy and iMG.
You can see your favor with all the Giants on the website or any time you 'Check Favor' with any one giant.
Some skills require you to spend an Emblem to unlock them.
Earn 11 Emblems of any one giant and you can make an Icon.
You can only earn so much favor with each Giant in a single game day: in fact, about one emblem's worth!
